refusedCell.requires: SECTION IX of the ratified drawing at the contract's pin, verbatim: 'Four hosts, one card set. The chat thread drawn throughout this page, the embedded site widget, the run card, and the page gate region. Every card appears on every host, and it is the same card wherever it appears: the same regions, the same states, the same data on screen, and the same actions its reader is authorized to take. Only the frame changes.' With the READER MATRIX, verbatim: 'May view and act | Card - actions live' under SITE WIDGET. THIS CELL IS DRIVEN TO RECORD A REFUSAL. `scripts/ci/lib/capture-record-contract.mjs` declares `agent_hitl_screen` capturable on `chat_thread` and `run_card` only, with the reason that 'a widget conversation cannot start a run that reaches `pending_approval`'. A run started by the widget's own named-agent start DOES reach it on this head, and the widget draws the card. The recorder's own words are reported in README.md.

refusals.message:
walk cell "S1__hitl-card__site_widget__asking__light" produced a record the index would refuse:
  record "S1__hitl-card__site_widget__asking__light": "agent_hitl_screen" is recorded as composition-only on "site_widget" — a card travels from the run's own turn, and a widget conversation cannot start a run that reaches `pending_approval`: `agent_run` is not in the delegated widget allowlist (packages/mcp-server/src/delegated-widget-tool-policy.ts), and the content-editor launch claims no present human and runs queued -> running -> completed without ever parking (src/lib/host-content-editor-dispatch.ts). The mount is real and is proven by the card suite's widget arms and the real-store submit tier; it is the PICTURE that has no reachable subject.
